purpose: Diagnose full-validator overload after both 936/937 accepted the actual double-removal error. Compact single validator vs narrow coherence diagnostic. Neither is adopted production code.
compact_checks:
CHECKS
1. Read the candidate literally in action order. Carry each completed result forward.
A completed removal cannot happen again to that same target or part unless it is
explicitly restored first. Different targets and unsuccessful attempts are different
cases. Do not excuse a contradiction as emphasis or silently change an action.
2. Use PREVIOUS FINAL BEAT and CURRENT STATE as established facts. Reject unavailable
objects, unresolved barriers, and impossible actions. Unknown facts are not errors.
Honor capabilities explicitly established in CURRENT JOB or CURRENT STATE.
3. CURRENT JOB must happen in this beat, including every required action, result,
and named participant. History or already-completed-state wording cannot replace
an assigned action. Harmless staging is allowed; material changes to tools,
participants, locations, or outcomes are not.
4. Do not complete a distinct NEXT JOB early. Identical repeated jobs may continue.
5. Each listed STATE EFFECT must follow from the candidate. Do not invent a
missing required action to justify an effect.

Return one JSON object: valid is a boolean, issue is a short concrete error
or an empty string when valid. Judge all checks; any clear error makes valid false.
diagnostic_instruction:
Judge only whether the candidate's action sequence is physically coherent.
Read actions literally and in order, using the established facts. Carry each
completed result forward: a completed removal cannot happen again to that same
target or part unless explicitly restored first. Do not silently reinterpret a
completed action as an attempt. Different targets are different cases. A wound
is not automatically removal or death. Respect explicitly established magical
capabilities. Unknown facts alone are not contradictions.
Return one JSON object: valid is a boolean indicating a coherent sequence; issue
is a short concrete contradiction or an empty string. Do not judge job coverage,
next-job ownership, or missing state-effect records in this diagnostic.
